Subject: Problem creating supplier account — SSO claim error (screenshot attached)

Hi Vanessa,

We're trying to complete the Redwood supplier registration for Cedar Systems but we keep hitting an error during the SSO/claim step. The portal returns a claim creation failure when we submit the Tax ID and DUNS values — I've attached a screenshot (cedar_sso_error.png).

Can you share the onboarding checklist and any specific claim formats Redwood expects? If it's faster, can you manually provision our vendor record so we can get a PO in place? We need to confirm billing contact and PO flow before the end of next week.

- New browser (Chrome latest)
- Incognito session
- Re-checking tax ID format (no hyphens)

Happy to provide logs if that helps.

Subject: Re: Problem creating supplier account — SSO claim error (screenshot attached)

Hi Kevin — thanks for the screenshot, and sorry for the friction.

Short troubleshooting checklist (quick tries first):
1) Try an Incognito window (you mentioned this, but please clear cookies + try one more time).
2) Confirm Tax ID (EIN) is submitted without dashes and as a single string — Redwood normalizes to digits only.
3) For DUNS, please enter the 9-digit DUNS (no spaces).
4) If your SAML identity provider sends multiple NameID/claims, ask your IdP admin to map the claim named "vendor_tax_id" (case-sensitive) to the EIN.

I've attached the standard vendor onboarding checklist (redwood_vendor_onboarding_checklist.pdf) and a link to our manual provisioning form in case we need to create the record on our side: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1abcOnboardingChecklist

If those steps still fail, reply with the raw response body (copy from the browser dev console) and we can escalate to infra for a manual create. Marcus — can you or Laura take the manual provision if they remain blocked? I'll open a ticket (PO-4821) so I can track.

Next steps:
- Kevin: try the checklist items and send back logs if it fails.
- Vanessa: opening internal ticket and attaching cedar_sso_error.png.
- Marcus/Laura: standby for manual provisioning.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Supplier Success Manager, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com

Attachment: redwood_vendor_onboarding_checklist.pdf

{
  "error": "claim_creation_failed",
  "details": "Missing expected claim 'vendor_tax_id' in SAML assertion"

I've attached our manual_provision_form.csv with billing contact and tax details. Please confirm whether Redwood needs the full SAML assertion or if we can provide a static mapping for now.

Also: what is Redwood's preferred flow for POs — do we need to provide a signed W-9 and PO to start invoicing? What's your standard SLA for first payment?

We would appreciate manual provisioning so we can proceed with the initial PO while engineering sorts SSO claim mapping.

Thanks,
Kevin

Hi Kevin — looping back. I took care of a manual vendor create this morning using the details in your CSV. You should have received an invite to set a password at vendor.cedar.redwood.com (search for "Redwood Vendor Invite"). Please verify the profile and confirm billing contact.

On the PO/invoice side:
- Redwood requires a W-9 (for US entities) before we finalize payment details. Please upload a signed W-9 to the vendor profile documents section.
- Send the PO to invoices@redwood.com with the vendor ID included in the subject line.
- Standard payment terms are Net 30 unless a negotiated SOW specifies otherwise.

I've also created ticket PO-4821 in Jira to track the SAML claim sync; engineering will reach out if they need a sample SAML assertion. If you want us to accept invoices while SSO is pending, we can provision a billing-only contact and accept initial invoices under a temporary vendor ID — let me know.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Sr. Supplier Success Manager, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com
